hooks.name: Lint & Format on Save
hooks.description: Run ESLint (TS/JS) or ruff/black (Python) with auto-fix on every source file save.

action.command:
FILE=$(echo "$KIRO_HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('file',''))" 2>/dev/null)
if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi

case "$FILE" in
  *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx)
    # Run ESLint with --fix if available, fall back gracefully
    if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
      npx --no-install eslint --fix "$FILE" 2>&1 && echo "ESLint: $FILE OK" || echo "ESLint: issues found in $FILE (see above)"
    else
      echo "ESLint: npx not found, skipping"
    fi
    ;;
  *.py)
    # Prefer ruff (faster), fall back to black
    if command -v ruff &>/dev/null; then
      ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>&1 && ruff format "$FILE" 2>&1 && echo "ruff: $FILE OK"
    elif command -v black &>/dev/null; then
      black "$FILE" 2>&1 && echo "black: $FILE OK"
    else
      echo "No Python formatter found (ruff or black). Skipping."
    fi
    ;;
esac
